vaultKey.unlockHint: This vault is encrypted. Enter its password to open it.
vaultKey.rememberHint: The key is kept in the operating system's keychain and the vault opens without a password. The files in the vault folder stay encrypted.
vaultKey.createHint: Everything in this vault is encrypted: entries, images and backups. Without the password or the recovery key you are about to receive, none of it can be read — not even by you.
vaultKey.recoverHint: Enter the recovery key and choose a new password. You then get a new recovery key — the old one stops working.
vaultKey.recoveryHint: This key gets you into your vault if you forget the password. It is shown only this once. Write it down or keep it in a password manager — not in the vault itself.
vaultKey.stored: I have stored the key safely
vaultKey.tooShort: The password needs at least {{count}} characters.
vaultKey.wrongRecoveryKey: This recovery key does not belong to this vault.
vaultKey.unlockFailed: Could not unlock the vault. Please try again.
vaultKey.recoverFailed: Could not set the new password. Please try again.
vaultKey.createFailed: Could not encrypt the vault. Please try again.
vaultKey.rememberUnavailable: This system has no keychain to remember the key in.
vaultKey.rememberFailed: The operating system's keychain refused to remember the key. The vault is open, but Emerald will ask for the password again next time.
vaultKey.encryptHint: This vault dates from before encryption. From now on every vault is encrypted: choose a password and Emerald encrypts entries, images and drafts. Depending on the size this takes a moment, and the original stays untouched until everything has been checked.
vaultKey.encryptNote: Backups you exported earlier (.emeralddb) stay unencrypted until you delete them. On SSDs, deleted files can sometimes be recovered for a while — only an encrypted disk (BitLocker, FileVault) closes that gap.
vaultKey.encryptFailed: Could not encrypt the vault. It is unchanged — please try again.
vaultKey.notEnoughSpace: Not enough free disk space: this temporarily needs {{needed}} more, and {{free}} is free. Nothing was changed.

security.rememberHint: Keeps the key in the system keychain so the vault opens without a password.
security.rememberError: The keychain did not accept the change.
security.changeHint: A new password and a new recovery key; the vault is re-encrypted and open tabs close.
security.changed: Password changed; the vault is encrypted under a new key.
security.changeFailed: Could not change the password. The vault is unchanged.
security.lockHint: Closes the vault now; the password is needed again, even if it is remembered.
security.lockTooltip: Close the vault and require the password
security.rememberTooltip: The files in the vault folder stay encrypted either way.
security.changeTooltip: Older backups still open with the password they were made with.
security.currentPasswordTooltip: The password you unlock this vault with
security.reopenFailed: The vault could not be reloaded afterwards. Restart Emerald — it opens with the new password.

settings.tagline: The workspace for your magickal practice.
settings.taglineDetail: Journal, wiki, operations, templates, altars and tasks in one place — all of it local to this machine, no cloud, no account.
settings.author: Author
settings.exportAllTimeHint: Every entry, whatever its date. Switch it off to pick a range.
settings.modeMergeDesc: Add all entries alongside existing ones (each entry gets a unique ID prefix)
settings.modeReplaceDesc: Delete all current data and restore from backup
settings.modeAddVaultDesc: Create a new, separate vault from the backup
settings.modeReplaceWarning: This will permanently delete all current data in this vault.
settings.autoBackupHint: Saves the whole vault as an .emeralddb file on a schedule: every entry, the trash, images and settings.
settings.autoBackupEnableHint: Runs while Emerald is open and the vault is unlocked. A backup that was due while the app was closed is made the next time it opens.
settings.autoBackupDailyHint: One backup per day, the first time Emerald is open that day.
settings.autoBackupWeeklyHint: One backup per week, on the chosen weekday or the first time Emerald is open after it.
settings.autoBackupMonthlyHint: One backup per month, on the 1st or the first time Emerald is open after it.
settings.autoBackupKeepHint: How many automatic backups stay; older ones are deleted. Backups you saved yourself are never touched.
settings.autoBackupFolderHint: The vault's own backup folder, or any folder you choose, including another drive. The choice applies to this computer only.
settings.autoBackupNowHint: Writes today's backup right away. A backup from earlier today is replaced.
settings.autoBackupErrorDirMissing: The backup folder cannot be reached. Connect the drive or choose another folder.
settings.autoBackupErrorFailed: The last automatic backup failed. Check the folder and try again.
settings.autoBackupErrorFolder: The folder could not be set.
settings.importErrorInvalid: File is not a valid Emerald backup.
settings.importErrorOutside: Emerald can only open backups from your own folders (home, Documents, Desktop, Downloads). Copy the file there first.
settings.updateRestartHint: Emerald restarts after installing. Your data is left untouched.
settings.updateUnsupported: This installation cannot update itself. Download the new version from the website and install it that way.
settings.updateSourceDesc: The address Emerald asks for new versions. Leave it empty to use the built-in sources. Change it only if that address ever changes — the signing key stays fixed, so another source cannot install anything.
settings.updateSourceInvalid: This must be a complete https address.
settings.updateAutoCheckDesc: Asks the source once per start. If something is found, a dot appears on the gear — no window ever opens on its own.
settings.updateErrorUnreachable: The update source could not be reached.
settings.updateErrorTarget: No update is offered for this platform.
settings.updateErrorStale: The update that was found is no longer held. Please check again.
settings.updateErrorWrite: The setting could not be saved.
settings.modeReplaceSettingsWarning: The settings of this vault are replaced by those from the backup as well.
settings.emojiItemTitle: Click to remove, drag to reorder
settings.uiScaleHint: Scales the whole interface — text, icons and spacing.
settings.editorFontSizeHint: Text size in entries and field values, independent of the UI size.
settings.sidebarListHint: Which entries the left sidebar shows: all of them, or one module's.
settings.sidebarLimitHint: How many entries a list shows at first. The rest loads below via “Show more”.
settings.emojiDefaultsHint: The emojis every emoji picker in this vault offers before you search. Click to remove, drag to reorder, search to add new ones.
settings.imagesHint: Applies to newly inserted images. Larger ones are scaled down first and only rejected if they are still too large.
settings.imageMaxEdgeOption: Larger images are scaled down to {{value}} px on their longest side
settings.tagCreationHint: Where new tags may be created — typing, templates, and importing .emerald files. A backup always brings its tags along.
settings.tagCreateInlineHint: An unknown name — typed, from a template or from an import — becomes a new tag
settings.tagCreateDashboardOnlyHint: The tag field, templates and imports only take existing tags. Create new tags in Tags.
settings.templateDefaultHint: Whether a new entry starts with the default template for its entry type and category. A template can always be inserted by hand.
settings.templateDefaultAutoHint: A new entry starts with its default template. Changing its category or entry type later leaves the content alone.
settings.templateDefaultManualHint: New entries start empty and offer the matching templates to choose from.
settings.editorFormattingHint: What the editor converts on its own while you type or paste. Applies to every editor opened afterwards.
settings.markdownShortcutsHint: “# ” becomes a heading, “- ” a list, “> ” a quote, “[ ] ” a task, and **bold** and ==highlight== become formatting.
settings.typographyHint: Straight quotes become curly ones, -- an em dash, -> an arrow, 1/2 becomes ½.
settings.autoLinksHint: A typed or pasted address becomes a link.
settings.moonPhaseHint: The moon phase of the day a journal entry was created.
settings.moonPhaseShowHint: Applies to every entry, old ones included. Off: no moon phase as icon, in the sidebar or in exports, and no filtering or grouping by it.
settings.trashRetentionHint: How long deleted items stay in the trash. After that they are removed for good when the vault opens.
settings.languageHint: The interface language in this vault.
settings.appearanceHint: Color scheme, fonts and sizes of this vault.
settings.uiFontHint: Font for menus, lists and labels.
settings.editorFontHint: Font for titles and text in entries.
settings.exportDbHint: Saves the vault as an .emeralddb file, images included. The choices below decide what goes in.
settings.includeSettingsHint: This vault's language, appearance, sidebar, trash, emoji, image, tag, template and automatic backup settings
settings.importDbHint: Brings back an .emeralddb file — as a new vault, alongside the existing entries, or replacing everything. The options appear once a file is picked.
settings.storageHint: Images in the vault folder that no entry uses anymore. “Scan” shows how much space they take, “Remove” deletes them for good.
settings.updatesDesc: Checks whether a newer version of Emerald exists, and installs it.
